events.title: Licinius publishes the agreement known as the Edict of Milan
events.description: At Nicomedia, Emperor Licinius issued the letter agreed with Constantine granting freedom of worship to Christians and all others. Confiscated church property was ordered returned.
events.html: At Nicomedia, Emperor Licinius issued the letter agreed with Constantine granting freedom of worship to Christians and all others. Confiscated church property was ordered returned.

events.title: Peasants' Revolt rebels enter London
events.description: Wat Tyler's rebels crossed London Bridge and burned John of Gaunt's Savoy Palace. The next day they stormed the Tower and beheaded the Archbishop of Canterbury.
events.html: Wat Tyler's rebels crossed London Bridge and burned John of Gaunt's Savoy Palace. The next day they stormed the Tower and beheaded the Archbishop of Canterbury.

events.title: Martin Luther marries Katharina von Bora
events.description: The former monk married a former nun in Wittenberg. Their marriage became a model for the Protestant clerical household.
events.html: The former monk married a former nun in Wittenberg. Their marriage became a model for the Protestant clerical household.

events.title: Ludwig II of Bavaria is found drowned
events.description: Days after being declared insane and deposed, the builder of Neuschwanstein was found dead in Lake Starnberg with his psychiatrist. The circumstances have never been explained.
events.html: Days after being declared insane and deposed, the builder of Neuschwanstein was found dead in Lake Starnberg with his psychiatrist. The circumstances have never been explained.

events.title: Supreme Court decides Miranda v. Arizona
events.description: The Court ruled that suspects must be told of their right to remain silent and to have a lawyer before police questioning. The 'Miranda warning' became standard practice.
events.html: The Court ruled that suspects must be told of their right to remain silent and to have a lawyer before police questioning. The 'Miranda warning' became standard practice.
